newsitem.title: FRANCE: RUGBY UNION-FRENCH DOUBTS OVER BENAZZI AND PELOUS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-FRENCH DOUBTS OVER BENAZZI AND PELOUS.

text.p: French captain Abdelatif Benazzi could miss his country's Five Nations rugby union decider against Scotland at Parc des Princes on March 15.

Benazzi, who sustained a rib injury helping the French clinch their first win over England in Twickenham for a decade last Saturday, has been unable to train with his club Agen this week and faces a race against time to be fit to face the Scots.
France, hoping to complete their first grand slam in 10 years, may be forced into a major reorganisation of their back-row.
Dax number eight Fabien Pelous is nursing an injured right hip and is also doubtful.
